text:
yu: heads-up: trying to make the JS SDK seamless across Node (CJS), ESM bundlers, and edge runtimes. Local smoke is fine, but our edge example errors with `TypeError: sdk.default is not a constructor` after esbuild bundles it.
adele: that screams ESM/CJS interop. Are examples still using default import?
yu: yes, examples/edge does `import SDK from 'redwood-sdk'` for brevity. Our ESM output currently only has named exports. CJS shim sets module.exports.default but esbuild/worker ends up without a default.
li: two practical fixes: 1) change the ESM build to also emit a default export, 2) add an explicit worker/edge subpath in package.json `exports` so edge bundlers grab a dedicated ESM file. Example: "./worker": { "import": "./dist/esm/worker.js", "types": "./dist/types/worker.d.ts" }.
yu: adding `./worker` seems safer for progressive rollout. We could also document recommended imports for each runtime.
adele: agree. Also watch TS resolution: include `types` inside the subpath export, otherwise tsc/tsserver might resolve wrong d.ts for `import 'redwood-sdk/worker'`. Consider adding `typesVersions` for older TS.
li: small runtime gotcha: our retry helper retries fetches but some callers pass a ReadableStream body. In Node cloning works, in worker it gets drained and second attempt sends empty body.
yu: current helper: `async function retryFetch(init){ for (let i=0;i<2;i++){ const r = await fetch(url, init); if (r.ok) return r; }}` — we pass init.body directly.
adele: fix options: buffer bodies before retry (ArrayBuffer) or change API to accept a factory: `retryFetch(() => ({ body: createBody() }))`. Buffering has cost; factory is more explicit. Add a small helper `ensureRetryable(init)` that buffers only when needed.
li: and ship a tiny `edge-fetch-shim` exported from `./worker` that normalizes cloning behavior so examples are simpler. Make it opt-in so Node users don't pay copy costs.
yu: I'll prototype: 1) worker subpath + types, 2) ESM default export in build, 3) `ensureRetryableBody` util and `edge-fetch-shim` in the worker entry, 4) examples/edge that import the worker entry and CI smoke deploy.
ops-bot: deploy preview 5678 failed earlier with `TypeError: sdk.default is not a constructor` — will re-run after PR.
devx-bot: created issue DX-5244: "sdk: add worker subpath + default export parity + retry-friendly bodies" assigned to @yu.
yu: thanks — will open PR with minimal repro and link the Vercel/CF deploy previews. :thumbsup:
